hero.title: Made With You, Not Just For You
hero.subtitle: Welcome to Mumburi. We make things slowly, by hand, and we'd rather make one good piece than a hundred quick ones.

makers.heading: Let’s grow together.
makers.description: Drop your handle below if you make things too, or just want to show off where a Mumburi piece landed.
makers.studioNoteText: No auto-replies here. If you write in, I read it myself.

wholesale.title: Let’s stock your shelves together.
wholesale.description: We like working with boutiques and galleries who aren't in a rush either. No big contracts or sales pitch needed — just reach out and we'll figure out if it's a good fit.
wholesale.footerNote: I'D LOVE TO SEE YOUR INSTAGRAM OR PORTFOLIO TOO!
